title: Handmade Sitalpati Handbag | Cane Handle Woven Bag | GrassCrafts
descriptionHtml:
Handmade Sitalpati Handbag — Wear the Heritage of Bengal

Discover the charm of this handmade Sitalpati handbag — uniquely crafted for you with a stylish cane handle. Each bag is custom-made by skilled artisans using the finest Sitalpati grass, ensuring an eco-friendly, one-of-a-kind piece you won’t find anywhere else.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Handcrafted from sustainably harvested Sitalpati grass
  • Stylish cane handle — custom-made & unique to each piece
  • Naturally cooling to touch — ideal for warm climates
  • 100% eco-friendly & biodegradable
  • Rooted in Bengal’s GI-tagged weaving heritage
